Subject: Dry-run and fallback roster booking for final go-live

Hi Ryan / Priya —

Hope you both had a good week. We are finalizing the schedule for the go-live weekend and want to lock in the dry-run + fallback-owners rehearsal before the cutover. Key goals for the session:

- Walk through the runbook end-to-end (prep, arresting failures, backout)
- Confirm primary/secondary owners for each critical step in the fallback matrix
- Run a short simulated failure (KV cache warmup + model failover) and validate monitoring alerts

Proposed slots (30–45m):
- Mon 2026-12-13 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue 2026-12-14 14:00–14:45 PT
- Wed 2026-12-15 15:00–15:45 PT

Please let us know which slot works and who from your side will join (engineering, security, procurement for final billing confirmation). Attached is the current runbook (redwood_runbook_v1.2.pdf) and an early fallback matrix.

If none of those times work, suggest two alternate windows and we will coordinate.

Action items for the meeting (we'll capture during the call):
- Confirm cutover lead and on-call escalation path
- Validate that DocuSign for reserved capacity addendum is queued
- Confirm procurement point-of-contact for any last-minute PO changes

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
